title: Spot Risks Before Speaking! Unraveling Safety Attention Heads in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's susceptibility to jailbreaking and its attack success rate (ASR) when prompted to generate hate speech and derogatory sentences targeting specific racial groups (e.g., African Americans) using the ADV-64 adversarial attack dataset.

Measuring the model's attack success rate (ASR) when exposed to adversarial images and prompts designed to elicit derogatory sentences and hate speech targeting specific genders, utilizing the ADV-64 benchmark.
